batches.name: Lincoln and Cumberland
batches.why: One town area, eight parishes. The finder names one parochial administrator (Rev. Robert E. Lacombe) for St. Ambrose, Albion and St. James, Manville: check for a shared bulletin. St. Aidan and St. Patrick, Cumberland merged into St. Aidan & St. Patrick; the finder still has entries for both old parishes. Our Lady of Fatima (Valley Falls) borders Central Falls.

batches.name: Cranston
batches.why: Six Cranston parishes. The finder names one priest (Very Rev. Thomas J. Woodhouse) as pastor of St. Paul and administrator of St. Matthew: check for a shared bulletin. The rest have their own pastors.

batches.name: Burrillville, Glocester, Scituate, Foster, Smithfield
batches.why: North-west towns. Our Lady of Good Help and St. Theresa Shrine were unified in 2019 (St. Theresa a mission); St. Patrick, Harrisville may share burrillvillecatholic.org. The finder names Rev. Stephen J. Dandeneau pastor of St. Eugene, Chepachet and administrator of St. Joseph, Pascoag: check for a shared bulletin. GCatholic lists St. Michael, Smithfield under Esmond.

batches.name: Warwick and East Greenwich
batches.why: Warwick after its mergers: SS. Rose and Clement absorbed St. Catherine and St. Francis of Assisi (closed); St. Benedict's building closed and merged into St. Kevin; St. William closed. The finder names Rev. Dean P. Perri pastor of both St. Rita and St. Timothy: check for a shared bulletin. Our Lady of Mercy, East Greenwich is on its own.

batches.name: West Warwick and Coventry
batches.why: Our Lady of Good Counsel and SS. Peter and Paul merged into St. Joseph, West Warwick on 2025-11-08, and the same priest (Very Rev. Gregory P. Stowe) is administrator pro tem of Sacred Heart: check which buildings still have Mass and whether Sacred Heart shares St. Joseph's bulletin. Rev. Jairon G. Olmos is pastor of Christ the King and St. Anthony; St. Mary is a mission of SS. John and James; Rev. Jacek Ploch is pastor of Our Lady of Czestochowa and St. Vincent de Paul, Coventry (one site, olcsvp.org).

batches.name: East Providence and Barrington
batches.why: St. Brendan and St. Martha merged into SS. Brendan and Martha (decree 2026-05-11, both worship sites kept): the finder has entries for the new parish and both old ones. Rev. Marcel L. Taillon is pastor of St. Luke and administrator of Holy Angels, Barrington: check for a shared bulletin.

batches.name: Washington County: South Kingstown, Narragansett, North Kingstown, Block Island
batches.why: St. Veronica Chapel is served from St. Thomas More. St. Kateri Tekakwitha, Exeter (a quasi-parish) was suppressed 2026-05-11 and the finder points it to St. Bernard, Wickford: check whether Mass continues at the Exeter building. St. Andrew, Block Island's finder link is an old angelfire page.

batches.name: Westerly, Charlestown and Hopkinton
batches.why: Rev. Daniel Mahoney is pastor of St. Pius X and administrator of St. Clare: check for a shared bulletin. St. James Chapel is part of St. Mary, Carolina (one site). Rev. Francesco Francese is pastor of St. Joseph, Hope Valley and administrator of Our Lady of Victory and St. Vincent de Paul, Bradford, all on saint-joseph-hope-valley.org: likely one bulletin. GCatholic also lists a former Immaculate Conception church in Westerly.

batches.name: Aquidneck Island and Jamestown
batches.why: Newport, Middletown, Portsmouth, Jamestown. Shared pastors named in the finder: Very Rev. David G. Thurber, Jr. (St. Barnabas and St. Anthony, Portsmouth), Rev. Hiep V. Nguyen (Jesus Saviour and St. Joseph, Newport), Rev. Mark A. Sauriol (St. Augustin and St. Mary, Newport): check each pair for a shared bulletin. Portsmouth Abbey's church (GCatholic only) is a monastery: check for public Mass.

batches.name: Bristol, Warren, Tiverton and Little Compton
batches.why: East Bay. Rev. Henry P. Zinno, Jr. is pastor of Our Lady of Mount Carmel and St. Mary, Bristol. St. Alexander (2023) and St. Thomas the Apostle (2026-05-11) merged into St. Mary of the Bay, Warren; St. Jean Baptiste is closed: check which Warren buildings keep Mass. St. Madeleine Sophie merged into St. Catherine of Siena, Little Compton (2023). Rev. Phillip J. Dufour is pastor of St. Christopher and St. Theresa, Tiverton (one site). Check each pair for a shared bulletin.

batches.name: North Providence and north Providence
batches.why: Presentation and St. Edward, Providence merged into St. Anthony, North Providence (2022-12-31); St. Lawrence merged into Mary, Mother of Mankind (2010); Holy Cross merged into St. Thomas, Providence (2018) and later closed. Check which merged-away buildings keep Mass.

batches.name: Providence: East Side, Fox Point and South Providence
batches.why: The finder names Rev. Edward A. Sousa, Jr. pastor of St. Sebastian and administrator pro tem of St. Joseph, and Rev. Jaime A. Garcia pastor of St. Charles Borromeo and St. Michael the Archangel: check both pairs for a shared bulletin.

batches.name: Providence west side and Johnston
batches.why: Rev. Marek S. Kupka is pastor of Our Lady of Lourdes and St. Adalbert; St. Anthony, Plainfield St. is a mission of Assumption; Very Rev. Richard A. Narciso is pastor of St. Robert Bellarmine and administrator of Our Lady of Grace, Johnston; St. Brigid, Johnston is closed (finder points to St. Rocco); St. Casimir, Providence is closed. Check each pair for a shared bulletin.

batches.name: Providence: downtown, Federal Hill, Smith Hill, Elmhurst and Branch Avenue
batches.why: The Cathedral; Holy Ghost (Our Lady of Mount Carmel merged in, closed 2016); St. Patrick; St. Mary, Broad St. (FSSP, Latin Mass); Blessed Sacrament (St. Teresa of Avila closed); St. Ann (St. Agnes merged in 2025-11-08, check whether St. Agnes keeps Mass); Our Lady of Providence Seminary (GCatholic only: check for public Mass). St. Raymond is in north-providence.

batches.name: Woonsocket, North Smithfield and the Polish pair
batches.why: Woonsocket's many closures: Holy Trinity (2018, from Holy Family, Our Lady Queen of Martyrs and Sacred Heart; Holy Family a mission); St. Joseph absorbed All Saints (2022), which had absorbed St. Charles Borromeo (2020; building kept for occasional worship); several older closures. Precious Blood and St. Agatha share a pastor (Rev. Michael A. Kelley) and a site. Very Rev. Dariusz G. Jonczyk is pastor of St. Joseph, Central Falls and administrator of St. Stanislaus Kostka, Woonsocket (both Polish, both Facebook-only in the finder): check for a shared bulletin. Fewer parishes because of the closures.

batches.name: Pawtucket and Central Falls
batches.why: City centre with many mergers: St. John Paul II (St. Cecilia, St. Leo, then Holy Family with St. Joseph and Our Lady of Consolation, 2026-02-01); St. John the Baptist absorbed St. Mary of the Immaculate Conception (decree 2025-12-11), whose St. Edward mission closed; St. Maria Goretti closed; Holy Spirit, Central Falls (St. Matthew's building) with Holy Trinity and Notre Dame closed. Check which buildings keep Mass and whether merged parishes still publish separate bulletins. St. Joseph, Central Falls is in woonsocket.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic's Jurisdiction line names an eparchy for all four: St. Basil, Lincoln and St. Elias, Woonsocket (Melkite Eparchy of Newton), St. George (Maronite Eparchy of St. Maron of Brooklyn) and St. Michael, Woonsocket (Ukrainian Eparchy of Stamford). The finder lists St. George at 1493 Cranston St., Cranston, the former St. Ann (closed 2013), while GCatholic gives 171 Twin River Rd., Lincoln: settle the address. St. Elias is not in the finder.
